name: Hino Nazako
source:
Hino is Hibi's younger sister and hina's twin sister, when she meets Toma for the first time, she sees him as a rival in sport and always wants to play with him.
[spoiler]When Toma saves Hino, Hino immediately falls in love under of his savior and calls it TomTom[/spoiler]
